about: WP32 inputs to implementation/review-ledger.json that git history cannot supply: files read in full and left unchanged, explicitly reviewed working-tree changes bound to their SHA-256 bytes and oracles, and the environment lanes as recorded in docs/implementation/validation.md. Regenerate the ledger with `npm run review:ledger`; `review-closure` checks it. Historical lane entries do not certify later working-tree changes. DR29: withdrawn stale byte-bound review claims for src/runtime/personal-settings.ts, src/entry/personal-host.ts, src/entry/oma-mac.ts. Hashes were not silently refreshed; these edited owners require fresh review. Historical readUnchanged entries apply only to unchanged committed files; changed files are NOT_REVIEWED.

reviewedChanges.note: Read in full: sync and async effects retain exact primary/cleanup outcomes, including thrown null/undefined; cleanup runs once after the effect settles and is awaited. Outcome-matrix and nested corruption/publication-knowledge assertions pass; five source-copy controls assertion-killed. This helper assembles ownership returns, not error classification, process-death proof or publication retry policy.

Read in full: only observed contention returns null; failed acquisition preserves primary beside close failure, contended close is not repeated, close revokes descriptor access before the fallible return. Two source-copy controls assertion-killed. Existing inode identity/fence rules retained; native Darwin flock and inherited descendant death are not proved by controlled composition.

Read in full: held parent/pin returns preserve original failure; if pin/root return prevents transfer, the opened result is locally returned once, retaining both failures. Untransferred-result leak control assertion-killed. openat2 containment has no fallback and is not weakened. closeEvery still reports the first close failure after attempting all returns; this review does not claim all caller finally paths are closed.

Read in full: HostTemporary owns one close, marks returned before close, and discard attempts temporary-name removal even after close failure. Replacement/publication preserve primary beside cleanup; an already reused descriptor number is not reclosed. Three source-copy controls assertion-killed. Existing full-file publication and host-private namespace remain; visible-name uncertainty, whole retry policy and actual Mac durability are not certified.

Read in full: input ownership starts before output acquisition, nested cleanup returns output then input despite failure; failed sealer construction retains discard failure. Two source-copy controls assertion-killed after correcting the constructor oracle's TypeError (initial INVALID not counted). Existing archive bytes/AES-GCM/chunk authentication unchanged; real Keychain, native Mac execution and all stream-sink lifetime boundaries remain separate.

Read in full: partial snapshot ownership spans clone/publication and discard; primary plus discard and cleanup-only outcomes are not success. Discard-removal control assertion-killed. Actual local-fixture snapshot regressions pass. Running-snapshot maintenance/control/society cleanup and clone/thaw failure composition remain open; no native VM, APFS or power-cut proof.

Read in full: settings/adoption writer returns and nested engine-file/parent returns preserve primary failure. Parent-leak control assertion-killed; controlled adoption fails on directory observation before opening any credential file. Bundled-only engine resolution, separate engine home and one retry owner retained. No actual auth.json was read; all pre-transfer absence and native credential adoption boundaries are not certified.

Read in full: an acquired reader's close/read failure is not absence; bounded UTF-8/identity/single-name checks retained. Darwin immutable publication returns its writer and temporary while preserving primary beside cleanup and flushes existing destination on retry. Post-open ENOENT-to-absence control assertion-killed. Linux contained resolution retained; native Darwin crash durability and pre-transfer pin-close absence composition are not certified.

Read in full: serialized per-item writer uses a cross-process lock and awaits the fenced writer before returning it; abort and identity are rechecked before write. Controlled in-memory store failure beside lock close and cleanup-only failure retain exact outcomes. Native Swift helper, real Keychain and credential execution were not exercised.

Read in full at the 2026-10-01 host-only package checkpoint: platform-aware runtime metadata preparation completes before spawn; explicit engine/store/arguments/environment/fence, error retained until actual direct-child close, and signal/null/nonzero close not success. Fourteen controlled tests pass; eleven source-copy controls assertion-killed under complete TAP with no cancellations/skips or harness errors, including the direct exit-only oracle. Actual Mac entry/bundled package manager and installed Personal PTY pass on Linux. Actual close does not establish arbitrary descendant/cgroup death; fallible listener acquisition and native Mac execution remain open. No credential files or real provider used.

Read in full: one scoped native ESM generation owner, complete selected-path replacement before generation advance, relative/late imports retain their parent's generation, unrelated engine modules unchanged, hook deregistration on close. Seven actual bundled-loader/native-cache tests pass. Generation identity is not a byte snapshot or a bound on accumulated engine/module memory. Native Mac and hook registration/deregistration failure injection are not proved.

Read in full at the 2026-10-01 host-only package checkpoint: one value-aware grammar produces an immutable explicit Mac-only local decision, strips host-only from engine argv, and refuses duplicate/value-like/project combinations and Linux use before effects. Five source-copy grammar controls assertion-killed through the actual parser imported by entry composition. Shared package index validation/publication, explicit activation and per-source reconciliation retained; actual loopback npm install/list/update/remove and ordinary package regressions pass. Installing locally does not select a Personal extension or consume an absent first-project seed. Whole index crash/retry boundaries and native Mac package durability are not certified by this limited review. No new Host API or guest protocol method/state/version.

Read in full: child owns snapshot creation, engine walker group, EOF cancellation and cleanup; parent bounds output and duration. Caller-death and uncooperative walker tests; EOF and group-cleanup mutants assertion-killed. Does not claim cleanup after the owner itself is SIGKILLed or an OS crash.

Read in full: frame-bounded base64 chunks bind exact receipt JSON identity and extent; collection rejects changed digest, oversize, gaps and incomplete replies. Real broker/ledger restart test retains one effect and isolates actors; dispatcher supplies the authenticated actor, never a wire actor.

Read in full: frame-bounded status response includes a lexicographic continuation, refuses an individually oversized row, and does not claim a cross-page snapshot. This is response pagination, not database keyset pagination.

Read in full: bounded-buffer regular-file hashing retains pre/post identity and observed-size checks; large executable asset, spawn tamper and stale-generation tests pass; document-cap, spawn-digest and commit-digest mutants killed. Does not eliminate same-UID replacement after the read.

Read in full: canonical project/Society/basename/header identity, exact shape and round trip; traversal, added cwd, malformed references and replaced identity are rejected by DR29 guest-history tests. Pure value codec; no writer or native proof.

Read in full: canonical Personal birth/basename/header identity, typed exact query and bounded metadata page validation. DR29 reference/traversal, pagination and strict successful-exit oracles pass. A reference locates facts and does not grant execution.

Read in full: one private duplex socket owns correlated observations, per-query monotonic timer/cancellation, late replies and one flushed final handoff. Real local socket plus actual Linux PTY holder and cancellation/partial/loss tests pass. Native Mac and systemd holder launch NOT_RUN.

Read in full: existing saved Personal birth/header/cwd admission and real SDK metadata, no registry and no guest-supplied paths. Real history replacement/corruption, paginated count/preview and actual controlled holder oracles pass. Remote text search is preview-only; no native Mac execution claim.

Read in full: existing project binding and Society birth/header/private cwd admission, lexical bounded pagination, SDK-skipped files remain unknown. Real saved files and scripted launcher/current listening holder conflict oracles pass. Actual manager launch NOT_RUN.

Read in full: bundle-owned one-shot helper argv/stdin, bounded output and actual-exit plus strict reply validation. Controlled helper tests pass; Foundation bookmark implementation is NOT_BUILT/NOT_RUN on this Linux host.

Read in full: host-record binding/bookmark/Git identity precedes already-running project settings observation; absent binding is empty, ambiguity/unknown is refusal. Real Git relocation/replacement and controlled settings tests pass. Bound first seed requires an already running app/guest, and native Mac NOT_RUN.

Read in full: composition callback consumes frozen exact candidate/check profile, cgroup resources, private raw checkout and confined argv/environment; controlled command/manager-outcome oracles pass. Actual systemd/cgroup probe remains independently denied and NOT_RUN; builder tests do not certify kernel enforcement.
